set.body: Outcome: keep throwing literal constructors out of the public MVPA API. Acceptance: public IDs, axes, measurements, designs, estimands, execution values, and predictive IDs expose total validating constructors; trusted unsafe construction is companion-private or package-internal; public consumer compile demonstrates the boundary; internal constants avoid unchecked get/throw where construction can fail; JVM/JS courts pass.
set.title: P7.2b: internalize unsafe constructors and totalize public construction
